etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: From at least the Heian period. Appears to be a compound or conjugation, but the ultimate derivation is unknown.

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text:
The 連(れん)用(よう)形(けい) (ren'yōkei, “stem or continuative form”) of the verb 熱(ほと)る (hotoru, “to heat up (intransitive), to become hot”)..
The verb 熱る (hotoru) is attested since at least 1283. The date of first use of this verb form as an independent noun is currently uncertain, but would be some time after that.
